messages:
sanjay: Quick follow-up from the fused-attn RFC — proposing a small runtime shim that exposes polymorphic ops so model backends can pick fused-QKV vs split-QKV at call time. Thoughts?

elaine: Like a runtime-dispatch layer? yes, that's what we discussed in rfc but wanted concrete API surface.

sanjay: Exactly. Proposal sketch:

```
// pseudo-dispatch
if (kernel_caps.fused_qkv && !request.flags.force_separate && !model.needs_dropout) {
  run_fused_qkv(request);
} else {
  run_split_qkv(request);
}
```

mike: Two quick concerns: 1) bias+rope ordering — fused kernel must accept rope-applied QKV or perform rope inside. 2) telemetry for correctness/regression.

elaine: Agree. For (1) we should add `rope_location` hint: `pre_qkv | in_kernel | post_qkv`. For (2) add a cheap checksum on outputs and sample diffs.

anton: Dropout-free path: we can expose a `dropout_mode: inference | training` flag. For onnx/torch exported models with dropout baked, runtime should treat `inference` as deterministic.

rebecca: Ops-level ABI: variant name + capability bitmask. Keep it minimal: `name`, `supports_rope`, `supports_bias_fuse`, `requires_dropout_support`.

devx: Need devtools support: `redwood-inspect kernels` to list supported kernels + perf microbenchmarks. Also guidance for model authors.

deploy-bot: canary deploy queued for `eng-runtime` at 03:15 UTC :shipit:

mike: One more: fallback latency tail — if fused fails mid-request (OOM or assert) must atomically restart on split path or return 5xx? I'd prefer restart on split path.

sanjay: Good call. We'll implement try/catch + deterministic retry on split path. Add metric `runtime.fused_retry_count`.

elaine: I'll open a short RFC addendum with the ABI, hints, and metric list. Assigning to @sanjay for the sketch. ETA EOD tomorrow.

sanjay: Thanks — small action items: (1) elaIne RFC addendum, (2) infra: `redwood-inspect` stub, (3) runtime: implement dispatch + retry. I'll put tasks in GH.

anton: tagging perf team to run perf matrix: batch sizes [1,8,32], seq [32,512], qkv_fused vs split.

rebecca: + reminder: add GRPC/HTTP flag so user can force path for debugging: `X-Redwood-Kernel: split|fused|auto`.

sanjay: sgtm. closing here unless urgent.

mike: :thumbsup:

elaine: :eyes:
